title: Concept: Possible an SMTP password passed with --smtp-password in source
description: an SMTP password passed with --smtp-password written into a script ships with the repository and with every build log that echoes the command. Rotation plus removing the literal argument is the durable fix.
applicability: Shell scripts, CI job definitions, Dockerfiles, Makefiles and runbooks that may contain an SMTP password passed with --smtp-password.
risk: Use of the credential by anyone who can read the script, the image or the CI log; HIGH severity.
